info.about: The X-Files: Resist or Serve is a 2004 survival horror game developed by Black Ops Entertainment and published by Vivendi Universal Games for the PlayStation 2. It is the third video game based on the television series The X-Files, after The X-Files: Unrestricted Access (1997) and The X-Files Game (1998).
info.trivia: David Duchovny and Gillian Anderson voice Mulder and Scully, and the script was written by Thomas Schnauz, who wrote two episodes of the series.
info.why: The planned Xbox version was cancelled, so this PS2 disc is the only release, and both X-Files collectors and survival-horror fans compete for it.
